concept.title: Welcome system
concept.shortdesc: The welcome system illuminates the vehicle’s surroundings or interior to improve visibility when the driver approaches or exits the vehicle.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleLightsWelcome mirror/lightOn door unlock or On driver approach on the infotainment system screen to enable the welcome light function.
When activated, the door handle lights turn on for approximately 15 seconds.
The lighting switch must be ON (AUTO position operates only at night).
All doors must be closed and locked.
When On door unlock is selected:
Press the door unlock button on the smart key or digital key.
Touch the sensor on the front outside door handle while carrying the smart key or digital key.
When On driver approach is selected:
Approach the front outside door handle within 1 m (40 inches) while carrying the smart key or digital key.
Select SettingsVehicleLightsWelcome mirror/lightOn door unlock or On driver approach on the infotainment system screen to enable the welcome light function.
When activated, the exterior lights turn on for approximately 15 seconds.
The lighting switch must be ON (AUTO position operates only at night).
All doors must be closed and locked. with the vehicle in OFF position
Press the door unlock button on the smart key or digital key.

section.title: Welcome light (room lamp)
section.p: When the welcome light function is enabled, the interior room lamps illuminate for approximately 30 seconds under the following conditions:

li.p: All doors (and tailgate) are closed and locked.
The touch sensor on the front outside door handle is touched.
The door unlock button on the smart key or digital key is pressed.
For more details, please scan the QR code in a separately supplied Car Infotainment System Quick Reference Guide.
The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more details, please refer to the web manual in the quick reference guide.

section.title: Dynamic welcome light
section.p: This feature dynamically illuminates the vehicle’s lights for a brief period when the driver unlocks the vehicle, enhancing its aesthetic appeal.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleLightsHeadlight time-out on the infotainment system screen to enable or adjust dynamic welcome light function.
When activated, the dynamic welcome light turns on for approximately 2 seconds.
The welcome light (exterior lights) operational conditions must be met.

sectiondiv.p: This feature dynamically illuminates the vehicle’s lights for a short period after the driver turns off the vehicle with the headlamps ON, enhancing its aesthetic appeal.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleLightsHeadlight time-out on the infotainment system screen to enable or adjust dynamic escort light function.
When activated, the dynamic escort light turns on after the headlamp escort function operating conditions are met.
